name: Colossus
introduce:
KX-101HA Colossus
Manufactured by Kamadar, this heavy ST is the culmination of second-generation technology.
Although a newly released model, the KX-101HA Colossus does not rely on a new design as its selling point. Instead, it integrates a large amount of mature and reliable existing technology—heavy composite armor, high-capacity weapon hardpoints, a streamlined shield generator, localized tactical data links, and more. These battle-tested technologies work smoothly together under the integration of the Iron Rain Transmuter, pushing the Colossus's basic performance to the extreme—even significantly ahead of some third-generation STs in certain parameters.

20544.name: Iron Rain Transmuter
20544.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>. For every <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo consumed, increases DMG Dealt by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

30448.name: Bulwark Array Mod
30448.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacked and hit, if not possessing a shield, a part that was hit but not destroyed, with HP percentage lower than <color=#F74848>70%</color>, gains a shield equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> of its Max HP after combat. This shield lasts until it is broken.
Upon gaining a shield, applies <buf ID=7100306>[DMG UP III]</buf> and <buf ID=7100106>[Hit Rate UP III]</buf> to self and <color=#F74848>1</color> random ally within a diamond-shaped <color=#F74848>2-tile</color> range. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
